text: Mobile app development is an exciting field today. When building an app, developers must think about responsive design, which means the app should work well on different screen sizes. They also choose between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one system, like Android or iOS, and often perform better. Cross-platform apps work on several systems at once, which saves time and money. After development, apps are published on app stores, such as Google Play or the App Store. However, performance is very important. If an app is slow or crashes, users will delete it quickly, so developers must test carefully before release.
